translations.web: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted.
translations.bsb: They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
translations.kjv: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
translations.asv: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
